faqs.question: What is WhatsApp Business API in Singapore, and how can businesses use it?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API, also called the WhatsApp Business Platform, helps growing businesses in Singapore communicate with customers without managing every conversation manually. It supports bulk campaigns, AI chatbots, CRM integrations, automated notifications, and customer support with multiple agents.
  • Singapore SMEs and enterprises can use it to manage order updates, appointment reminders, promotional campaigns, and customer enquiries.
  • And you don't need to be a developer to get started. With MSG91, businesses can connect WhatsApp, launch campaigns, create chatbots, and manage customer conversations through a simple, no-code dashboard.

faqs.question: Why should Singapore businesses choose MSG91 as their WhatsApp Business API provider?
faqs.answer:
• Managing customer communication shouldn't require technical expertise or multiple disconnected tools. MSG91 brings WhatsApp campaigns, AI chatbots, and customer support together in one easy-to-use platform.
  • Singapore businesses get a no-code dashboard to run WhatsApp campaigns, automate customer interactions, and manage conversations as they grow.
  • And MSG91 goes beyond WhatsApp. With MSG91 One API, businesses can connect SMS, RCS, email, WhatsApp, and voice through unified communication workflows.
  • You also get MSG91 Hello, an AI-powered customer support platform with a shared inbox for managing conversations across teams.
  • Trusted by 30,000+ businesses globally, MSG91 helps companies simplify customer communication while reducing the need for disconnected tools.

faqs.question: What is the pricing of WhatsApp Business API in Singapore?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API pricing in Singapore includes messaging charges and a platform subscription. MSG91 offers messaging rates approximately 10% lower than Meta's standard GBP pricing, helping businesses save on customer communication.
  • MSG91's rates for Singapore numbers (+65), in GBP, are:
    • Marketing: £0.04772 per message
    • Utility: £0.01043 per message
    • Authentication: £0.01043 per message
    • Service: £0.01043 per billable message after the free allowance
  • The MSG91 Titan plan costs £6/month, with the first two months free. Messaging charges and applicable taxes are separate.
  • For example, sending 10,000 billable marketing messages costs £477.20 with MSG91 compared with £528 at Meta's standard rate, saving £50.80 before subscription fees and taxes.
  • Actual savings depend on messaging volume, applicable pricing tiers, and billing arrangements.
  • For a detailed breakdown, explore MSG91 WhatsApp Business API Pricing in Singapore and Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Pricing.

faqs.question: How can Singapore businesses reduce WhatsApp customer support costs after Meta's October 2026 pricing changes?
faqs.answer:
• Since October 1, 2026, Meta has charged for WhatsApp service messages beyond its monthly free allowance. The first 1,000 service messages per business phone number remain free each month, while additional messages are chargeable.
  • Utility templates sent within an active customer service window also became chargeable, subject to applicable exceptions.
  • For Singapore businesses handling hundreds of customer enquiries every day, these additional expenses can quickly add up.
  • MSG91 Chat Window offers a simpler way to continue conversations: WhatsApp → Chat Window → Hello.
  • Customers begin on WhatsApp and move to a dedicated Chat Window through a link. AI chatbots and human agents can then continue assisting them through Hello without sending every response through WhatsApp.
  • Messages exchanged inside Chat Window don't incur Meta's WhatsApp messaging charges. Messages actually sent through WhatsApp remain chargeable.
  • Follow the MSG91 Chat Window setup guide to learn more.

faqs.question: Can Singapore businesses send WhatsApp OTPs, use WhatsApp Flows, and configure fallback channels?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 supports WhatsApp OTPs for account verification, secure sign-ins, and other eligible authentication workflows.
  • With the MSG91 OTP Widget, businesses can set up verification retries and supported alternative channels, including SMS, voice calls, and email.
  • WhatsApp Flows add another interactive capability. Customers can book appointments, fill in lead forms, register for events, and provide feedback directly within WhatsApp, without being redirected to an external form.
  • For example, a tuition centre can collect trial-class requests through a guided WhatsApp Flow, while a clinic can use another Flow for appointment enquiries.
  • For important notifications, supported MSG91 integrations can configure SMS, RCS, email, or voice as fallback options when WhatsApp delivery fails.
  • These workflows help businesses make customer communication more convenient, while channel-specific charges and eligibility conditions may apply.
  • Explore the OTP Widget integration guide.

faqs.question: Can Singapore businesses complete WhatsApp Cloud API setup without developers?
faqs.answer:
• Absolutely! MSG91 makes WhatsApp Cloud API setup simple, even for people without coding or technical experience. Our user-friendly dashboard guides you through connecting your WhatsApp number and getting started with automated communication.
  • Get started in four steps:
    • 1: Create your MSG91 account.
    • 2: Connect your Meta Business Portfolio.
    • 3: Add an eligible Singapore WhatsApp number (+65).
    • 4: Complete verification and configure your messages.
  • That's it! Once connected, you can create approved templates, run campaigns, configure supported chatbots, and manage conversations without writing code.

  • Need help? MSG91 offers 24/7 customer assistance, combining expert human support through email, WhatsApp, calls, and scheduled Google Meet sessions with round-the-clock AI that handles routine questions and complex technical enquiries.

  • From initial setup to everyday customer communication, MSG91 keeps things simple and connected.
